title: Apple hits record revenue; dividend boost and buyback expansion support bullish outlook
description: Apple reported record quarterly revenue with strong iPhone demand and double-digit Services growth, and announced a higher dividend plus an expanded buyback, fueling bullish after-hours price action. Ongoing component cost pressures from global supply disruptions remain a modest headwind.

title: Spot Bitcoin ETF Speculation Lifts BTC
description: Speculation that US regulators are nearing approval of spot Bitcoin ETFs has sparked a broad rally, lifting BTC toward recent highs as investors anticipate new institutional demand. Volatility could spike around any official decision, and a delay might reverse gains.

title: EURUSD Downward Pressure from Hawkish Fed Outlook and Sticky Inflation
description: Fed officials signaled a willingness to raise rates further, keeping policy hawkish and supporting the dollar. A hotter inflation read reinforces higher yields and weighs on EURUSD, suggesting near-term downside for the pair.

title: AI leadership signal supports upside for GOOGL
description: Alphabet's launch of its most advanced multimodal AI model, with deep integration across Search, Workspace, and Cloud, signals stronger monetization potential and sustained AI leadership, expanding revenue opportunities for GOOGL. Investor optimism suggests potential upside for the stock, though ongoing data-center spending remains a near-term headwind.

title: Oil poised higher on supply cuts and geopolitical risks
description: OPEC+ production cuts, Strait of Hormuz disruptions, and tightened Iranian sanctions collectively tighten global supply and raise a geopolitical risk premium, supporting higher crude prices in the near term. Early price action has already reflected gains.

title: SPY Under Pressure from Hawkish Fed, Sticky Inflation and Global Disruptions
description: A hawkish rate outlook and persistent inflation create headwinds for equities. Ongoing recession concerns and supply-chain disruptions amplify downside risk for SPY in the near term.
